elements.description: A big job fanned out to many workers: one cell per task, live.

properties.name: tasks
properties.description: Every task in the job, one cell each, in order – its label, state, worker, times, cost, result or error

properties.name: job
properties.description: What the whole job does – e.g. "Enrich 240 leads"

properties.name: workers
properties.description: How many workers run at once – used for the time left (defaults to the tasks running now)

properties.name: now
properties.description: The clock, in epoch ms – without it (and without `elapsed`) the element reads the clock and ticks while tasks run

properties.name: startedAt
properties.description: When the job started, in epoch ms – defaults to the earliest task start

properties.name: elapsed
properties.description: The clock as ms from the start of the job; task start/end are then job-relative too. Wins over `now`

properties.name: onRetry
properties.description:
"Retry failed" sends the failed tasks' ids here – unset, the button doesn't show. A promise holds the button
while it runs; a rejection says so and the button stays to try again

properties.name: selected
properties.description:
The id of the task whose window is kept open (null: none). Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change
listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: filter
properties.description:
The state every other cell steps back from (null: none). Changed by the user unless a tc-filter-change listener
calls preventDefault()

properties.name: formatCost
properties.description: Formats every cost – defaults to dollars, e.g. "$0.014"

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The header's icon (cloned); unset shows the default

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: The task kept open changes ({ selected: string | null }); cancelable

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: The state filter changes ({ filter: FanoutStatus | null }); cancelable

events.name: tc-select
events.description: A task was picked with a click or Enter, or let go ({ task: FanoutTask | null })

props.name: tasks
props.description: Every task in the job, one cell each, in order – its label, state, worker, times, cost, result or error

props.name: job
props.description: What the whole job does – e.g. "Enrich 240 leads"

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the task whose window is kept open. Controlled when defined (null: none)

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The task kept open on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the id of the task kept open (null when let go), controlled or not

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A task was picked (click or Enter) – null when it's let go

props.name: filter
props.description: The state every other cell steps back from. Controlled when defined (null: no filter)

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The filter on mount when `filter` isn't controlled

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the new filter, controlled or not

props.name: icon
props.description: A small mark before the title, e.g. the agent's logo

changelog: fan-out-grid cells and agent-queue backlog squares stay 12 px but sit 24 px apart, and each takes clicks across 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8) – the grids show fewer items per row.
